note: Delivered 5 of 20 (1 US, 4 MX). The cloud fetch tool only opens URLs surfaced in search results, so very few brand sites could be verified; the rest were dropped rather than guessed. All are WARM because team size or launch date could not be fully confirmed on the brand's site. Check Garza Rosa (site built by an outside provider) and Paradise MX (size unclear) before sending. Ads status unknown for all.

leads.signal: Sells Black Ginger at shop.tenneyson.com with 125 reviews and an affiliates program; age and team size not stated on the site, no retailers or press found
leads.what: Plant-based, 0% alcohol botanical spirit (Black Ginger) made with ginger, gentian root, dandelion, lemon balm, bergamot and yerba mate.
leads.why: The bottle, the pour and the serve ideas all look good on camera, so a steady flow of photos, reels and carousels can show recipes and serves month after month.
leads.dm: Hey! [post you liked.] Black Ginger, a plant-based non-alcoholic spirit, looks made for pour shots and serve carousels. I'm Daniel, I run a.creative studio. We deliver a monthly batch of ready-to-post photos, reels and carousels, made with just your product photos. No studio, no shoot. Mind if I send 3 quick ideas?
